svg.aria-label: QUAD-UAV, part of TRIAD (unmanned aerial vehicle ecosystem) by RESHAPE LAB. Quadcopter firmware: ESP32 flight link and STM32F103C8 PID.

g.text: ESP32 flight link and STM32F103C8 PID.
IMU, GPS, RC in, DShot out, telemetry, web dashboard
Receives RC from the handheld, sends telemetry back
ESP32 to STM32: RC down, MotorMix up
Handheld controller. src/RF_Protocol.h is shared, keep both in sync
